title: Discount Rates and Perk Credit Acceptance — Tailwise Training
content:
## Discount rates — Tailwise Training courses and packs

| Course or pack | Multi-dog discount | Tailwise Plus discount | Multi-dog and Plus discounts added together | Tailwise Plus Premier perk credit accepted toward the price |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Puppy Training 6-Week Group | 10% | 10% | No | Yes |
| Adult Basic Training 6-Week Group | 10% | 10% | No | Yes |
| Intermediate Training 6-Week Group | 10% | 10% | No | Yes |
| Advanced Training & CGC Prep 6-Week Group | 10% | 10% | No | Yes |
| Private Training 4-Session Pack | 0% | 10% | No | Yes |
| Private Training 8-Session Pack | 0% | 10% | No | Yes |

**Multi-dog discount.** The discount on a second enrollment of the same customer starting within 30 days of another: 10% on each group course and 0% on each private pack.

**Tailwise Plus discount.** The discount for an active Tailwise Plus tier: 10% on every Tailwise Training course and pack.

**Added together.** Whether the multi-dog and Tailwise Plus discounts are added together. On every course and pack the answer is no.

**Perk credit.** Whether Tailwise Plus Premier perk credit may pay toward the price. Every Tailwise Training course and pack accepts it.

Reading across the sheet: a private pack has only the Tailwise Plus rate of 10% available, since its multi-dog rate is 0%; a group course lists a 10% rate on each line.
